title: LCDS - Leão Consultoria e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas Ltda ME LAquis SCADA
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW IMPROPER ACCESS CONTROL CWE-284 An Improper Access Control vulnerability has been identified, which may allow an authenticated user to modify application files to escalate privileges. CVE-2017-6016 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 7.3 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ). RESEARCHER Karn Ganeshen identified and reported the vulnerability to ICS-CERT and tested the update. BACKGROUND Critical Infrastructure Sector(s): Chemical, Commercial Facilities, Energy, Food and Agriculture, Transportation Systems, Water and Wastewater Systems Countries/Areas Deployed: South America Company Headquarters Location: Joinville–SC, Brazil This product is provided subject to this  Notification  and this  Privacy & Use  policy.
